name: sol-luna-orchestration-kit
description: Evidence-driven Sol/Luna routing, status, and spawn guardrails for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Route bounded Luna work with evidence and guardrails.
interface.longDescription: Adds conversational setup and updates, Fast and Standard Sol/Luna routing profiles, one explicitly authorized Codex task fallback for native transport failures, privacy-safe milestone status, and an opt-in PreToolUse guard for supported subagent spawns.
defaultPrompt: Set up or update my Sol/Luna roles.
Route this milestone with the Sol/Luna SPLIT policy and offer one bounded Codex task if native Luna is unavailable.
Report Sol/Luna milestone status and drift.
